The '''jam sandwich''' is, as its name suggests, a [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|sandwich]] filled with [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]. It can be filled with any kind of jam.
==Ingredients==
*2 slices of [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]

*Some [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]] (any flavor)
==Procedure==
#Spread the jam onto the first slice of bread.
#Put the second slice of bread on top of the side of bread you have put the jam on.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If desired, the bread may be [[Cookbook:Toasting|toasted]] before sandwich assembly.
